# Rustic Roots Salon

> Hair salon based in Dripping Springs, Texas. Rustic Roots is Jackie and Katrina's salon tucked away on Old Fitzhugh Road, with soft lived-in blondes, beach waves, bridal hair and brows for the whole family.

- Phone: (512) 829-4405
- Based in: Dripping Springs, TX
- Nearby areas: Dripping Springs, Austin, Bee Cave, Wimberley, Driftwood
- Yelp rating: 4.0 from 12 reviews
- Book an appointment: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/rustic-roots-salon/quote.html
- Pick a time: https://ronaks-code.github.io/sitelift-demos/hair-salons/texas/rustic-roots-salon/book.html

## Services
- Cut & color: Lived-in blondes, balayage and dimensional color.
- Waves & styling: Soft waves and blowouts that last.
- Bridal hair: Trial runs and wedding-day styles for the bride and party.
- Brows & family cuts: Brow shaping and cuts for kids and teens.

## About
Rustic Roots Salon is a cute salon tucked on Old Fitzhugh Road in Dripping Springs. Owner Jackie opened it with business partner Katrina, and stylists Katie and Paige add bridal styling and brows. Clients have followed Jackie since 2014. They say she runs a tight, clean ship, keeps up with the latest trends and isn't afraid to have fun with color. Brides trust Katie and Katrina for wedding-day hair.

## Frequently asked questions
- Q: Do I need an appointment at Rustic Roots Salon?
  A: Appointments are best. Call (512) 829-4405 or book online and Rustic Roots will confirm by text.
- Q: Where is Rustic Roots Salon?
  A: 700 Old Fitzhugh Rd, Dripping Springs, TX. Parking is right outside.
- Q: Do you cut and color all hair types?
  A: Yes. Women's, men's and kids' cuts, color, highlights and styling for every hair type.
- Q: Can I bring inspiration photos?
  A: Please do. Photos help your stylist match the cut or color you have in mind.
- Q: What do clients say about Rustic Roots?
  A: Rustic Roots Salon is rated 4.0 stars from 12 Yelp reviews. Clients mention Jackie's skill and trend-savvy color, a clean, cute salon and great wedding hair.
- Q: Do you do Dripping Springs Tigers spirit hair?
  A: Yes. Spirit braids, ribbons and temporary color in school colors for homecoming and game nights. Mention it when you book.
